title: Burton's late three and Stokes' block lift Valkyries over Aces 83-81
meta_description: Vegas led for 11 seconds. Burton's 28-footer and Stokes's block gave the Valkyries an 83-81 win and a 2-0 lead.
hook: With 41.5 seconds left and the game tied at 76, Veronica Burton pulled up from 28 feet off a Gabby Williams pass and buried it. Then, with 3 seconds left and Vegas down two, Kiah Stokes blocked Chelsea Gray's reverse layup. The Golden State Valkyries won 83-81 and lead the Las Vegas Aces 2-0. Vegas led for 11 seconds all night.
summary: Golden State Valkyries 83, Las Vegas Aces 81, on October 7, 2026, at Chase Center. Golden State leads the best-of-five 2-0. Body is the draft, checked against ESPN game 401918298. No fact in the draft contradicted the ESPN summary, box score, or play-by-play, so the wording was kept. The closing italic line was removed because every stat came from ESPN. Game 3 is Friday, October 9, 2026, at 6:30 p.m. PT in Las Vegas on Peacock and NBCSN.
